ds_description: SYNTHETIC / NOTIONAL demonstration data — NOT operational and NOT classified. UK MoD JEWOSC electronic-warfare mission-data fusion demo: 500 synthetic ELINT/ES intercept cuts from a notional Baltic scenario, each fuzzy-matched (nearest emitter in normalized frequency/PRI/pulse-width space) against a 25-emitter threat library, then fused via native joins to the Electronic Order of Battle laydown and platform mission-data-file (MDF) coverage. One row per intercept. Use it to triage matched / ambiguous / unknown emitters, surface reprogramming triggers (cuts with no library match), rank threats by lethality and weapon-engagement range, find MDF coverage gaps, and read the own-ship tactical picture (range/bearing from BLUE-ISR ORBIT ALPHA). NATO-reporting-name-style designations and all parametrics are fabricated for audience resonance; no real emitter, EOB, or MDF data is present.

column_descriptions.intercept_id: Unique identifier for each ELINT/ES intercept cut (one row per detection).
column_descriptions.detect_time_iso: Timestamp the intercept was detected, ISO 8601 (UTC).
column_descriptions.lat: Latitude of the intercept geolocation, decimal degrees.
column_descriptions.lon: Longitude of the intercept geolocation, decimal degrees.
column_descriptions.band: Measured radar frequency band of the cut (e.g. S, C, X, Ku).
column_descriptions.meas_freq_ghz: Measured centre frequency of the intercepted emission, in GHz.
column_descriptions.meas_pri_us: Measured pulse repetition interval (PRI) of the cut, in microseconds; 0 for continuous-wave emitters.
column_descriptions.meas_pw_us: Measured pulse width of the cut, in microseconds.
column_descriptions.snr_db: Signal-to-noise ratio of the intercept, in decibels; low SNR degrades de-interleave confidence.
column_descriptions.bearing_deg_meas: Bearing to the emitter as measured by the collecting sensor, degrees (0 = North).
column_descriptions.sensor_id: Identifier of the ES/ELINT sensor that collected the cut.
column_descriptions.truth_emitter_id: Ground-truth emitter identity of the cut (demo scoring only; not used by the match).
column_descriptions.truth_class: Ground-truth emitter class label (demo scoring only; not used by the match).
column_descriptions.emitter_id: Library emitter the cut was matched to (the fusion join key); empty when the cut is unknown/unmatched, which flags a reprogramming trigger.
column_descriptions.match_distance: Normalized parametric distance from the measured cut to its best-match library emitter; lower is a tighter match.
column_descriptions.match_second_distance: Normalized parametric distance to the runner-up library emitter; a small gap to match_distance drives an ambiguous verdict.
column_descriptions.match_quality: Correlation verdict: matched (clean), ambiguous (close runner-up), or unknown (outside tolerance, no library match).
column_descriptions.is_reprogram_trigger: True when the cut is unknown/changed versus the threat library — a candidate for mission-data-file reprogramming.
column_descriptions.range_nm: Great-circle range from own-ship (BLUE-ISR ORBIT ALPHA) to the intercept, in nautical miles.
column_descriptions.bearing_deg: Bearing from own-ship to the intercept, degrees (0 = North).
column_descriptions.own_ship_label: Label of the own-ship reference platform used for range/bearing (notional BLUE-ISR ORBIT ALPHA).
column_descriptions.lib_nato_name: NATO-reporting-name-style designation of the matched emitter (notional).
column_descriptions.lib_system_type: Functional type of the matched emitter (e.g. EW/Surveillance, Acquisition, Engagement).
column_descriptions.lib_band: Frequency band recorded for the matched emitter in the threat library.
column_descriptions.lib_centre_freq_ghz: Library centre frequency of the matched emitter, GHz; compare against meas_freq_ghz.
column_descriptions.lib_pri_us: Library pulse repetition interval of the matched emitter, microseconds; compare against meas_pri_us.
column_descriptions.lib_pw_us: Library pulse width of the matched emitter, microseconds; compare against meas_pw_us.
column_descriptions.lib_scan_type: Antenna scan pattern recorded for the matched emitter (e.g. circular, sector, electronic).
column_descriptions.lib_erp_dbw: Library effective radiated power of the matched emitter, in dBW.
column_descriptions.lib_modes: Operating modes recorded for the matched emitter (e.g. search, track, guidance).
column_descriptions.lib_lethality: Threat lethality of the matched emitter: none, low, medium, high, or critical.
column_descriptions.lib_assoc_weapon: Weapon system associated with the matched emitter (e.g. SA-N-long, SHORAD); '-' if none.
column_descriptions.lib_max_range_km: Notional maximum engagement/detection range of the matched emitter's system, in kilometres.
column_descriptions.lib_threat_priority: Analyst priority ranking carried from the threat library for the matched emitter (higher = higher priority).
column_descriptions.eob_site_count: Number of known Electronic Order of Battle sites operating the matched emitter.
column_descriptions.eob_primary_affiliation: Dominant affiliation across known sites for the matched emitter: RED, BLUE, NEUTRAL, or NONE.
column_descriptions.eob_affiliations: All distinct site affiliations observed for the matched emitter, pipe-separated.
column_descriptions.eob_confirmed_count: Number of confirmed-confidence sites for the matched emitter.
column_descriptions.eob_active_count: Number of sites for the matched emitter currently assessed as active.
column_descriptions.eob_site_ids: Identifiers of the known EOB sites for the matched emitter, pipe-separated.
column_descriptions.eob_summary: Human-readable summary of the matched emitter's EOB laydown (site count, affiliation, confirmed/active).
column_descriptions.mdf_covered_count: Number of BLUE platform mission-data files (MDFs) that recognise the matched emitter.
column_descriptions.coverage_gap_count: Number of BLUE platform MDFs that do NOT recognise the matched emitter — the reprogramming workload.
column_descriptions.covering_platforms: Platforms whose MDF recognises the matched emitter, pipe-separated.
column_descriptions.uncovered_platforms: Platforms blind to the matched emitter (MDF gap), pipe-separated; the reprogramming priority list.
column_descriptions.coverage_summary: Human-readable summary of platform MDF coverage for the matched emitter.
column_descriptions.emitter_id-1: Duplicate emitter_id key retained by the threat-library join; use emitter_id instead.
column_descriptions.emitter_id-2: Duplicate emitter_id key retained by the EOB-laydown join; use emitter_id instead.
column_descriptions.emitter_id-3: Duplicate emitter_id key retained by the platform-coverage join; use emitter_id instead.
